headline: Session done — easy flat run landed almost exactly on script
summary: Prescribed was 45min flat Z1-Z2 at 138-148bpm; you ran 50min (3000s moving) at 151bpm average, cadence 82.6, RPE 4/feel 2 — a touch hot on HR but close enough to call it an easy aerobic day, not a quality breach. Load logged at 51 vs 40 estimated, which is in line with the usual HR-based load slightly overshooting an easy-day target rather than any red flag. Sleep last night was excellent (7.45h, score 90) and HRV is back up to 67, so the sleep-debt problem from the last few days looks resolved. No knee or pain flags in the data. Tomorrow's the long run (Sun 25, 2h45/~1050m D+ with two race-effort climbs) — today's session shouldn't have cost you anything for that, and the overnight rebound supports going into it fresh.
flags: Avg HR 151 is above the 138-148 easy band — minor, likely just the Levanto coastal path terrain (262m gain) rather than a pacing problem, but worth a one-line reminder before Sunday's key session.
ATL/CTL ramp is still negative/flat this week (-1.0 today) after Thursday's shortened Friday session — fine given the long run is the real test tomorrow.
suggestedChange: No plan change needed today — flag for Alberto to simply confirm Sunday's long run proceeds as scheduled given tonight's strong recovery numbers (HRV 67, sleep 7.45h).
